## The course dataset

The Healthy Hearts District Study is **simulated**: 480 adults aged 30 to 74 from four districts, measured at baseline and randomly allocated to standard advice or a lifestyle programme, with 12-month follow-up. It contains continuous, categorical, ordinal and count variables, realistic missing values and a `-99` code to clean. Results are for teaching only. The [data dictionary](downloads/data/data_dictionary.csv) describes every variable.

## Further reading

- Kirkwood BR, Sterne JAC. *Essential Medical Statistics*. 2nd ed. Blackwell Science; 2003.
- Agresti A. *An Introduction to Categorical Data Analysis*. 3rd ed. Wiley; 2019.
- Wickham H, Çetinkaya-Rundel M, Grolemund G. *R for Data Science*. 2nd ed. Free online: <https://r4ds.hadley.nz>
